name: mkopo-mcp
description: MCP server for alternative credit scoring in Kenya — M-PESA-based behavioral signals
author: Gabriel Mahia

tools.name: alternative_credit_score
tools.description: Compute a DEMONSTRATION alternative credit score and tier (PRIME, NEAR_PRIME, SUBPRIME or THIN_FILE) from M-PESA usage signals such as months of use, regular deposits, on-time utility payments and Fuliza debt. Use when exploring how alternative data could inform credit. This is NOT a credit score and not a CRB product: a synthetic heuristic with no real data. Automated decisions about people are regulated (Data Protection Act 2019, s.35; the AI Bill 2026 is only proposed, not law). Returns the score, tier and the signals used, with a notice. Read-only.

tools.name: mpesa_creditworthiness
tools.description: Estimate a person's savings rate, Fuliza dependence and affordable 12-month loan from average M-PESA inflows and outflows, months analysed, Fuliza usage and whether they run a business paybill. Use when exploring cash-flow-based lending. A DEMO analysis using a 30% debt service ratio: real lenders run formal CRB checks and set their own policy. Returns the financial profile, the debt service capacity and affordable loan, the basis and a notice. Read-only.

tools.name: credit_report_summary
tools.description: Produce a DEMONSTRATION credit report summary for a made-up applicant. Use only to show the format; this is NOT a CRB product. Do not enter a real person's name or ID number: the ID is masked so only its last 4 digits appear, and nothing is stored. Returns a report header, a risk level, recommendations and a disclaimer pointing to the real credit reference bureaus (crbafrica.co.ke, metropol.co.ke). Automated assessments of people are regulated under the Data Protection Act 2019. Read-only.

tools.name: loan_eligibility
tools.description: Match an income, credit tier and loan purpose to illustrative lender products and check the requested amount against a 30%-of-income repayment capacity. Use when someone asks what they might qualify for. credit_tier must be PRIME, NEAR_PRIME, SUBPRIME or THIN_FILE; an unrecognised tier gets the THIN_FILE products and credit_tier_applied says so. Returns the loan request, an affordability check, the eligible products, a recommendation and a notice. NOT real offers: rates are market estimates labelled DEMO. Read-only.

tools.name: credit_improvement_tips
tools.description: Practical steps to move up a credit tier, with an estimated timeline, based on the current tier, Fuliza debt, a CRB listing and months of saving. Use when someone asks how to improve their borrowing standing. An unrecognised tier gets the general timeline. Returns prioritised tips, the estimated improvement timeline and a notice. Educational guidance on DEMO assumptions: speak to a bank for personal advice. Read-only.
